quarterly_data.quarter: Hirano Tecseed annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026: net sales JPY 32,285 million (-33.2%), gross profit JPY 5,639 million (gross margin 17.5%), operating income JPY 1,599 million (-4.9%), ordinary income JPY 1,706 million (-9.9%), net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 1,313 million (+45.0%). Management states the EV market slowdown became clear in North America, its main market: after the US policy shift EV-related investment shrank sharply and major customers revised capex plans and postponed investment timing. Against the May 2025 forecast, net sales were JPY 1,214 million lower (forecast JPY 33,500 million), while ordinary income margin was 5.3% versus the 4.8% forecast.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hirano Tecseed annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management expects EV-related capex in North America to stay cautious and sees major customers revising capex plans, while it expects equipment renewal, modification and relocation demand driven by environmental and labor-saving / automation needs to hold firm; the company will strengthen sales outside North America and outside EV, and push modification, relocation and maintenance proposals to existing customers. Under the medium-term plan revised in November 2025 it is shifting from a strategy centered on raising capacity for EV-driven secondary-battery coating machines to one focused on developing thin-film new materials across advanced fields, putting profitability first. Its key indicator is ordinary income margin, with a target of 10% or more.
quarterly_data.figure: ordinary income margin target 10% or more

quarterly_data.quarter: Hirano Tecseed annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure for the fiscal year ended March 2026 totalled JPY 1,222,241 thousand, focused on product and R&D fields with long-term growth prospects plus rationalization and reliability; construction in progress rose with investment in R&D facilities (purchases of property, plant and equipment JPY 673 million). The company is investing to expand production of its core parts, high-precision rolls and slot dies. At the year-end it had no plans for new facilities or retirements that would materially affect results.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hirano Tecseed annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, fiscal year ended March 2026: group R&D expense JPY 512,822 thousand (Coating and laminating JPY 330,966 thousand; Industrial machinery JPY 181,855 thousand), about 30 staff, 182 patents held. A standard coating machine for perovskite solar cells, carrying Hirano's own digital twin for coating, drying and web-handling optimization, is to be installed in the company's Technicum test facility in fiscal year 2026 as the company numbers it (the year starting April 2026) to accept customer trial tests. Hirano Giken has installed new powder film-forming test equipment for next-generation secondary-battery dry-electrode processes; Hirano K&E has started work toward introducing a new multi test machine (vacuum deposition, double-sided vacuum film forming, plasma surface modification). In printed circuit board materials, improved transport, high-temperature pressing and laminating technology contributed to practical use of thin, high-density multilayer substrates; development continues on transparent polyimide film forming, carbon fiber sheet forming, high-temperature stretching, high-temperature heat treatment and continuous sputtering equipment.
